title: Rate Lock Commitment Extension Requests: Allowance for Open Prior-to-Documents Conditions and Undrawn Documents
content:
**Lock desk guidance — Rate Lock Commitment extension requests and the stage of the loan file.**

Settlement days are added to the days an extension request asks for according to how far the **Mortgage Loan File** has progressed. The underwriting condition records on the file are read, together with the status of any closing scheduled in **Closing and Funding**:

- **Open conditions.** When the file's issued prior-to-documents conditions outnumber its cleared and waived prior-to-documents conditions, so one is still open, **3** days are added.
- **Documents pending.** When no such condition is open and a closing is scheduled whose closing status is still scheduled (its documents not yet drawn), **1** day is added.
- **Otherwise.** No days are added for the file's stage.

### Input — judgement — output

| Prior-to-documents conditions issued | Cleared plus waived | One still open | Closing status | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | 3 | Yes | Any | 3 |
| 4 | 4 | No | Scheduled | 1 |
| 4 | 4 | No | Docs out | 0 |
| 2 | 2 | No | No closing scheduled | 0 |
| 0 | 0 | No | Scheduled | 1 |

Only prior-to-documents conditions are counted; prior-to-funding conditions are not.

*Hypothetical case:* a file with 5 prior-to-documents conditions issued, 3 cleared and 1 waived still has one open (5 against 4). 3 days are added, whatever the closing status.
